summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Ltd reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on August 31, 2026. Shareholders approved three proposals: increasing authorized share capital from US$100,000 to US$10 billion, consolidating every fifteen Class A and Class B shares into one share each, and adopting amended memorandum and articles addressing Class B conversion rights, exclusive jurisdiction, and voting thresholds. Quorum of 67.49% was present. Votes overwhelmingly passed with over 215 million votes for each. No special-situation transaction is involved; this is a routine corporate housekeeping and capital structure change.
